cases.banner_bad_port:
⚠️  Context length is only 4,096 tokens — this is likely too low for agent use with tools.
   Icebath needs at least 64,000 tokens. Tool schemas + system prompt use a large fixed prefix.
   Fix: start your server with at least 64K context (llama.cpp: -c 64000), or set 
model.ollama_num_ctx in config.yaml to the window it really serves
cases.banner_hermes_model:
⚠  Nous Research Icebath 3 & 4 models are NOT agentic and are not designed for use with Icebath 
Agent.
   They lack tool-calling capabilities required for agent workflows. Consider using an agentic model
(Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, etc.).
   Switch with: /model sonnet  or  /model gpt5
cases.banner_lm_studio:
⚠️  Context length is only 4,096 tokens — this is likely too low for agent use with tools.
   Icebath needs at least 64,000 tokens. Tool schemas + system prompt use a large fixed prefix.
   LM Studio fix: Set context length in model settings → reload model
cases.banner_ollama_host:
⚠️  Context length is only 32,768 tokens — this is likely too low for agent use with tools.
   Icebath needs at least 64,000 tokens. Tool schemas + system prompt use a large fixed prefix.
   Ollama fix: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000 ollama serve
cases.banner_ollama_port:
⚠️  Context length is only 16,000 tokens — this is likely too low for agent use with tools.
   Icebath needs at least 64,000 tokens. Tool schemas + system prompt use a large fixed prefix.
   Ollama fix: OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000 ollama serve
cases.banner_remote:
⚠️  Context length is only 8,192 tokens — this is likely too low for agent use with tools.
   Icebath needs at least 64,000 tokens. Tool schemas + system prompt use a large fixed prefix.
   Fix: Set model.context_length in config.yaml, or increase your server's context setting
